packet.title: Task-Orchestrator Workflow Idea Write-Path Serialization Fix
packet.root_cause: task-orchestrator propagated a pathlib.PosixPath workspace_id from workspace detection into the bridge-backed custom-data JSON payload, causing POST /api/workflow/ideas to fail before network dispatch

planned_slices.objective: Reproduce and trace the live write failure
Validate workflow idea creation and readback
Finalize review, precommit, proof, and PR state

completed_slices.summary: Reproduced HTTP 503 from POST /api/workflow/ideas and traced the first non-serializable object to workflow_store workspace_id
Normalized workflow store workspace_id to string and added targeted store/route regression coverage
Validated empty-state read, idea create success, idea readback, and adjacent epics route through the in-process ASGI runtime with a Path workspace_id input path
verification: POST /api/workflow/ideas after fix -> 201 with created idea payload

completed_slices.summary: Ran codereview, precommit, and created draft PR with proof artifact
verification: PAL codereview completed with no remaining medium-or-higher findings

replan_events.reason: The existing services/task-orchestrator/tests/test_workflow.py file is stale against current runtime behavior and could not serve as packet proof
replan_events.action: Added packet-specific regression coverage instead of widening repairs to unrelated stale tests

skipped_or_abandoned_slices.rationale: Challenge and code-path inspection showed the offending value originates in task-orchestrator-owned workspace_id, so widening bridge/shared-client normalization would expand authority and mask producer drift

failing_post_before_fix.detail: Failed to upsert custom_data workflow_ideas/<generated-id>: Object of type PosixPath is not JSON serializable

finalization.evidence_ledger_completeness: complete for the reproduced serialization seam
residual_risks: This packet verifies the reproduced workflow idea serialization seam and adjacent read-path behavior in targeted runtime proof; it does not prove that other unrelated services never leak non-JSON-native path-like objects elsewhere in the repo
The broader legacy services/task-orchestrator/tests/test_workflow.py file remains stale and was not repaired because it is outside this packet scope
